quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on building team chemistry during training camp
quotes.excerpt: We were just trying to build, build on what we've been doing in training camp.
quotes.quote: We were just trying to build, build on what we've been doing in training camp. It did feel good to get everyone who was active tonight out there and get some run.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the team's ongoing chemistry development
quotes.excerpt: We're still trying to learn each other on the floor.
quotes.quote: It's a small sample size. We're still trying to learn each other on the floor. We're still trying to put each other in a position to be successful and compliment each other the best way we can on the floor. It's going to take some time, but tonight was a good sample size for us to build on.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the importance of early transition offense
quotes.excerpt: I think it's always important just to be able to attack offensively before the defense is set.
quotes.quote: I think it's always important just to be able to attack offensively before the defense is set. Anytime we can get some early transition points or early attacks against defenses that are not set, we have VJ, Tyrese, and Jalen Brunson. We're able to punch gaps, especially if they have a numbers advantage or even a one-on-one advantage. The guys are not going to be able to stay in front of them, so it's great we were able to connect on a couple of them tonight.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on adjusting to a new team and uniform
quotes.excerpt: It felt a little different, obviously, wearing a new uniform.
quotes.quote: It felt a little different, obviously, wearing a new uniform, but the game is the game and the game needs to be played on the floor. I was happy to be able to log some minutes with the guys that we've been going at each other in practice for last week or a week and a half. It was great to finally just go out there and log some time with the guys that we know are not going to be in the fold.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on Dean Wade's versatility and team fit
quotes.excerpt: He fits on any basketball team on the planet.
quotes.quote: He fits on any basketball team on the planet. You got to have guys like that in order to win, but he could play for any basketball team on the planet and he'd fit right in.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on realizing his global impact during Nike tour
quotes.excerpt: I saw the impact and I saw my name being said and jerseys being worn.
quotes.quote: I would probably say my first time I went to China on a Nike tour. I think I was either 19 or 20 years old and I saw the impact and I saw my name being said and jerseys being worn and my shoes being worn all the way on the other side of the world. I saw the impact that I gave to that community in certain cities that we traveled throughout that tour. That was very eye-opening.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on playing against an aggressive team
quotes.excerpt: I thought we played some pretty good ball.
quotes.quote: I thought we played some pretty good ball. Obviously, the unforced turnovers, giving them pick-sixes, a team like that is very active, has a lot of speed, a lot of length. Their job is to get up and pressure you, to try to make you play against the shot clock, obviously, letting the shot clock. Besides the pick-sixes turnovers that we had, we played some really good ball and it's good to go against a team like that.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on adjusting his personal routine with a new team
quotes.quote: It's definitely an adjustment. Obviously, I have my routine, but when you go through an offseason, you got to remember what your routine was again. It doesn't matter how long you've been in it. Thinking about which bus do I remember taking? What was my routine when I got over to the arena? How do I get ready for the game? How was I laying my clothes out? All that stuff plays a part. I'm still getting into the whole everything, on the court and off the court.
